styles.css: /* wp-ja-nova: dark mode. The source (JA Nova, Joomla 6 T4) follows the OS until the visitor picks: its head script sets html[data-theme] from prefers-color-scheme, the .t4-theme-toggle button switches it (css/darkmode.css, js/darkmode.js). Here every colour preset carries both halves through light-dark(): light = tokens.css (measured 29/09 on :8271), dark = the source's --dm-* block (css/darkmode.css: bg #14171c, band #1a1e25, surface #1e232b, border #2e353f, text #c2c9d2, heading #eef1f6, muted #8b94a0, link #9d8cff, link hover #b6a9ff; the primary #5e48db is kept), each read back as computed style in the design contract (desktop-dark). The footer band is #212529 in light and the page background in dark, as measured. No attribute = auto, the OS decides; assets/js/wp-ja-nova-dark.js writes data-theme light|dark from the tracy_theme cookie before the first paint. */ :root{color-scheme:light dark;--wp--preset--color--bg:light-dark(var(--ds-c-bg, #ffffff),var(--ds-c-bg, #14171c));--wp--preset--color--surface:light-dark(var(--ds-c-surface, #f7f7f7),var(--ds-c-surface, #1a1e25));--wp--preset--color--surface-warm:light-dark(var(--ds-c-ink, #212529),var(--ds-c-ink, #14171c));--wp--preset--color--fg:light-dark(var(--ds-c-fg, rgba(19,21,21,0.7)),var(--ds-c-fg, #c2c9d2));--wp--preset--color--fg-2:light-dark(var(--ds-c-heading, #333333),var(--ds-c-heading, #eef1f6));--wp--preset--color--muted:light-dark(var(--ds-c-muted, #6c757d),var(--ds-c-muted, #8b94a0));--wp--preset--color--meta:light-dark(var(--ds-c-meta, #6c757d),var(--ds-c-meta, #8b94a0));--wp--preset--color--border:light-dark(var(--ds-c-border, rgba(0,0,0,0.1)),var(--ds-c-border, #2e353f));--wp--preset--color--border-soft:light-dark(var(--ds-c-border-soft, rgba(0,0,0,0.1)),var(--ds-c-border-soft, #2e353f));--wp--preset--color--accent:light-dark(var(--ds-c-accent, #5e48db),var(--ds-c-accent, #5e48db));--wp--preset--color--accent-on:light-dark(var(--ds-c-accent-on, #ffffff),var(--ds-c-accent-on, #ffffff));--wp--preset--color--accent-hover:light-dark(var(--ds-c-accent-hover, #3014cc),var(--ds-c-accent-hover, #b6a9ff));--wp--preset--color--accent-active:light-dark(var(--ds-c-accent-active, #371bd3),var(--ds-c-accent-active, #9d8cff));}:root[data-theme="light"]{color-scheme:light}:root[data-theme="dark"]{color-scheme:dark}
